steps.name: Legacy arrays migrate once, deduplicate, and preserve unreviewed feedback without guessing labels
Initial visible blocks, exclusions, nested blocks and matching warning explanations
Closed Shadow DOM isolates hostile page CSS and toggles Why details
Actual toolbar popup shows completed scan with current warnings
New comments scan incrementally without resubmitting unchanged text or duplicate warnings
Edited and removed comments lose stale warnings immediately
Character edits and hide/show changes invalidate only affected blocks
Moving a warned block into a form removes its old warning and rescans when moved back
Sensitivity changes reevaluate existing text with the actual API decision
Popup shows loading, and disabling during a pending response prevents warnings returning
Inline outline values and !important priorities restore; page changes survive cleanup
Edits, removals, and sensitivity changes reject stale in-flight results
No-detections completion and popup reopen show current state, not history totals
Real API-offline state and retry recover without misleading completion
Detection records deduplicate across rescans and retain full prediction snapshots
Two tabs save concurrent unique reports without loss and repeated saves produce one record
Popup report and incorrect actions deduplicate; incorrect feedback has no inferred replacement label
Human review keeps independent uncertain labels and preserves drafts during other-tab saves
Separate views export actual local JSON downloads; reviewed export excludes unreviewed feedback
Retention evicts oldest records above 200 per view without changing feedback or detections
Scope-aware clear affects only the selected view and site; all-site clear is separate
Records demo contains protected labels, safe comments, abuse and separate profanity-only warnings

limitations: Headless Brave, isolated temporary profile; no existing browser profile was accessed.
Temporary extension copy changes API port and grants only the demo origin for programmatic popup access (normal toolbar clicks grant activeTab).
Temporary instrumentation counts full discovery and delays real API responses; model outputs are not mocked.
Closed Shadow DOM is inspected through Chrome DevTools Protocol.
